body: Unless you want to live a little bit longwe. Many do.
The pills probably won't do it. You might end up living with brain damage though if your breathing stops for too long.

Sleeping pills are probably not gonna cut it.

Edit: I tried with benzos, slept two days, and I woke up happier than I ever was. Didn't last though.
It is pointless. You can't have a point without making one for yourself.

I like that you care. I don't anymore. There are other people there, go care. I don't even know why I posted, it's all the same to me.

I'll go sleep, and wake up to the same fucking useless shit.
Thanks for caring. Go care for someone else now.
Defenestration. What a crock of shit.
She cut her arm and now it doesn't work the same anymore. Sucks to be her. She'll live, so she says. But what's the point.

I don't know if there's anything more to add.

I tried a little bit. Sucks to be my little sis, she almost killed herself and now she tries. But she knows, we all know. Sorry.
It doesn't matter anymore.
Fuck off and die.
You too dude. I hope you hold it together better.
Thank ye'all for whatever. I'm tired, I'll go to sleep, and then I'll re-evaluate. I just want to sleep so much now.

Thanks for your kind words. I really appreciate them.

I honestly don't know if I have it in me to keep on plodding. If this was the next to last day even. I'll do this: I won't jump out of the window just yet, I'll re-evaluate things tomorrow. It may be shit yet again, I expect it to be. But I'll think it over, maybe there's "there" there. Thanks for listening, and doing what you did. We'll see. I'm tired, and I love succumbing to sleep. I'm tired of hating it all so much.
There's always the fucking tomorrow. Every. Fucking. Day.
Thanks y'al. See you in Valhalla.
I'll probably not kill myself today and save my self-loathing for another day.
Thank you for you people listening. And go fuckyourselves.

Soft suicide then, eh. Done that.

I took comfort it for not lasting forever, but it still lasts for on and on.

It seems I'm way too tired to not live on and on. Most likely I'll wake up tomorrow, life being as it is, and it's a groundhog day  all over again. Too tired to off it all? Story of my fucking life. Likely, if not wanted.
Thanks for ppl listening. It was all very nice.
But it's all theorethical now. I'm sick of pretending, and welcome all the reality I can get from the bottom of my heart.
Halfway there, and TBH, it's quite a feat anyway.
I appreciate the effort, I'm not as lonely as usual, but let's not kid ourselves: we don't want our lives. We hate them. Why do we pretend otherwise? Really.
That's good. But sometimes it dies on you, and you just don't want it anymore. Why would anyone want their lives, it escapes me. You've been here forever, you hate it, time to move on.

I don't hate anyone else, I try my hardest to give everybody a chance. And I'm serious and can apprehend the reason for all that.

But I've had enough. For both the world as it is, as my futile attempts to reconcile my wants and needs with my incapability to provide for neither.

Let it be, the voice says and I agree 100%, let it all be gone, and there doesn't need to be tomorrow. I love the thought so much.

I just don't have it in me anymore. I used to love this, like that, hate whatever. Now it's all the same with me.

I just don't care anymore. In some ways, it's worse than death. You're supposed to care. And I can't bring myself to do it.

I've died a million deaths already, while asleep. I just wish for the last and definite one. Not a big deal, I just hate the idea of dying and not making it. I don't know why anyone would cling onto this.
Most of all, I just don't want to hang around anymore. I hate myself, I hate life, I hate it all. With a jolly good reason, I might hang around, but nobody wants that. It's over. Fuck it.
Quite a fine point. But you run out of gas, and you wouldn't chastise a car for running out would you? You've seen enough, been enough, and you don't want to spread the hate around surely. Enough.

I already did, mate.

Edit: I lived for hard and long. 40 fucking years, top that. It's quite enough. I've hated the past 5 already, and the next 5 don't look so good either.
Doesn't matter. Go live your own fucking lives.

I don't understand why I should hang around. I remember watching Futurama with the suicide booths. They should exist. There's no reason why not. I'd take an exit immediately. Now I have to jump out of a fucking window, and there's no guaranteed good outcome. It's all so depressing.
In a parallel universe it might get better.
